title: Avoid SUBSTRING intermediate Vec<char>
description: Replace SUBSTRING evaluation's intermediate Vec<char> allocation with byte slicing based on computed character boundaries.

criteria: SUBSTRING evaluation no longer collects chars into Vec<char>
Out-of-range start positions still return an empty string
Focused helper test covers ASCII-compatible and multibyte character boundaries

notes: The helper finds UTF-8 byte boundaries for character offsets without allocating a Vec<char>.
SUBSTRING still evaluates arguments once and preserves the previous one-based start and optional length behavior.
SQL regression coverage includes ASCII and multibyte-character substring cases.
